query: Explain the difference between synchronous and asynchronous I/O in Python in under 200 characters. Keep it clear for beginner developers.
ground_truth_reference: Sync I/O in Python blocks execution until tasks complete. Async I/O lets other operations run while waiting on I/O. Think: waiting in line vs a restaurant buzzer.
